approval.scope: healthcare privacy, consent language, route eligibility, and downstream request semantics

requiredChecks: GA4 property and web stream are client-owned and confirmed.
Service-account Viewer access is granted to the agency-managed connector identity.
Property timezone matches the reporting assignment.
Healthcare analytics eligibility and consent language are approved.
Only approved routes use analytics_status approved.
GA4 DebugView shows each implemented event exactly once after consent, including file_download and numeric form_step.
Only the five approved UTM keys may appear in page_location, and unapproved query strings or fragments fail closed.
No prohibited parameter, page title, referrer, query value, fragment, form value, or patient-related data reaches GA4.
The appointment endpoint and privacy policy describe the same production behavior.
